example/toolkit

Small helpers for text pipelines. No runtime dependencies, one binary per tool.

InstallUsageLicense

Install

cargo install --path crates/toolkit
toolkit --version

Usage

Read a directory of pages and print the readable text of each one.

toolkit extract --input pages/ --format jsonl > out.jsonl

Note: the extractor keeps table rows as Markdown pipes so downstream tools can split at the pipes.

Options

  • --input directory to read
  • --format one of jsonl, text
  • --limit maximum characters per page
